project_detail.lead: A developer-focused AI application that combines a native macOS experience, provider-independent AI chat, and secure Git project analysis in one modular Swift SDK.
project_detail.overview_title: Chat, voice, and code in one app
project_detail.overview: AIChat is a native macOS application for real-time communication with OpenAI-compatible AI services. It includes multi-conversation management, persistent history, Markdown and code blocks, file attachments, voice conversations, and local Git repository inspection. Its core capabilities are modularized in AIChatSDK for reuse by other macOS applications.

items: Reusable and customizable AIChatSDK

project_detail.architecture: A layered architecture with one-way dependencies keeps the UI from directly accessing URLSession, Core Data, Keychain, or Git infrastructure. Provider-independent integrations and protocol-based boundaries keep the SDK extensible and testable.
project_detail.role: I developed the requirements, architecture, SwiftUI interface, authentication, AI provider integrations, persistence layer, multimodal file support, voice experience, Git-based Code Mode, SDK modularization, tests, and technical documentation.
